description.zh: 在 OperitAI 側邊欄中連線 VitalMesh 後端，讀取 iPhone / Apple Watch 的心率與健康數據。注意：本插件採輕量原始碼架構，需本機環境提供 Node.js (>=20) 與 npm；首次手動啟動服務會執行 npm 安裝依賴 (ws) 並在 /home/ubuntu/vitalmesh-source 部署原始碼與監聽 0.0.0.0:8123 本機服務；使用者健康數據存於 /home/ubuntu/vitalmesh-data。若 npm 網路連線逾時，可配置鏡像源或代理。
description.en: Connect to VitalMesh backend in OperitAI sidebar to read heart-rate and health data from iPhone / Apple Watch. Notice: Requires local Node.js (>=20) and npm. First manual start deploys source code to /home/ubuntu/vitalmesh-source, runs npm install for dependencies, listens on 0.0.0.0:8123 HTTP service, and stores health data in /home/ubuntu/vitalmesh-data.
description.default: VitalMesh Health Bridge for OperitAI sidebar. Requires Node.js >=20 & npm, deploys source, listens on 0.0.0.0:8123.

description.zh: 讀取 VitalMesh 後端的心率與健康數據，供 AI 對話中查詢與健康諮詢。
description.en: Read heart-rate and health data from the VitalMesh backend for AI chat queries.
